title: MMC SMP
description: A community driven SMP, open to all people that install our modpack. Connect easily with a join-server button on the main menu! We offer plenty of create integrations, and exploration.
body:
MMC SMP is a 1.21.1 NeoForge pack built around Create and Immersive Engineering.

It’s mostly focused on mechanical automation and industrial-style builds, with better world generation and some quality of life. The idea was to keep it grounded and cohesive instead of throwing in a bunch of unrelated mods.

![divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd01f9aa9ee5a3df7dfea495061c646558db9019_0.webp)

What’s in it

Create (with Additions, Big Cannons, Winery, Food, etc.) handles most of the automation. Immersive Engineering adds heavier multiblock machines and proper power systems.

World generation is upgraded with Terralith, Regions Unexplored, and the full YUNG’s structure suite. Strongholds, monuments, temples, mineshafts — all improved.

There are more mobs (Alex’s Mobs, Mowzie’s Mobs), better storage (Tom’s Storage, Sophisticated Storage), and some survival improvements like Farmer’s Delight and Gravestone.

Performance is covered too — Sodium, FerriteCore, Not Enough Crashes, Distant Horizons — so it runs well even once builds get bigger.

![divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd01f9aa9ee5a3df7dfea495061c646558db9019_0.webp)

Multiplayer

There’s an official MMC SMP server running this pack.

Open Parties & Claims is included for land protection. Simple Voice Chat is enabled. It’s just survival with other people — build, automate, explore, or start a factory town if you want.
